reviewer.role: Review sub-agent auditing disagreements; not a scoring reviewer

scope.inputs: Frozen round2 review JSON/Markdown and kydns-01-after originals; pinned authority and applicable instructions.
scope.resources: Python stdlib, PNG hash/header reads, one frozen Git object, individual original-detail image views. No pixel diff, installs or repository code execution.

authority.anchor_7: Solid, consistent components with minor visible rhythm/contrast/emphasis slips.
authority.anchor_9: Refined, nothing to remove, even rhythm and unambiguous states.
authority.threshold: abs(Opus - Sol) >= 2 per quality or separate Ky-fit dimension; individually reinspect, never average.

opus.pair_recipe: SHA256(uint64_be(JSON byte length) || exact JSON bytes || uint64_be(Markdown byte length) || exact Markdown bytes)

sol.pair_recipe: SHA256(uint64_be(JSON byte length) || exact JSON bytes || uint64_be(Markdown byte length) || exact Markdown bytes)

opus.recipe: json.dumps(files, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False).encode('utf-8'), no newline

sol.recipe: json.dumps(files, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False).encode('utf-8'), no newline

progression_preserved.policy: Only Opus current-round overall quality mean, half-up to one decimal, controls the 8.0 gate. No peer/history/brand pooling or individual/cohort/auditor veto. Owner rejection reopens progression.

opus_published_overall.label: coverage summary, not a competitive ranking

progression_preserved.audit_effect: No score or gate change. Parent owns the bounded batch and later progression decision.

quality_threshold_audits.opus_published_observation: Radios and selected card read clearly, but the nav row starts with a clipped "cklists" fragment and has no fade or chevron telling the user it scrolls.
quality_threshold_audits.sol_published_observation: Match system shows a selected radio and orange card border; the other seven fully visible cards have empty radios.
quality_threshold_audits.individual_image_observation: Eight complete two-column cards; selected Match system border/radio; clipped cklists fragment.
quality_threshold_audits.supported: Selected Appearance card/radios and Settings Save/field outlines are clear. Each affected phone navigation also starts with a clipped label fragment and no explicit fade/chevron.
quality_threshold_audits.anchor_difference: Opus 7 weighs the entire screen including a minor navigation discoverability slip (solid). Sol 9 emphasizes clear task controls (refined). Sol rationale omits the nav when justifying this whole-screen dimension.
quality_threshold_audits.qualification: Clipping can itself imply continuation; no explicit cue does not prove unusable navigation, keyboard failure or inaccessible scrolling.
quality_threshold_audits.resolution: Keep both observations and all ratings. Explicit continuation cue is a bounded polish candidate.

quality_threshold_audits.opus_published_observation: Stat rows, charts and table are each tidy, but mono axis text, two misaligned stat grids and a repeated metrics table read as three vocabularies.
quality_threshold_audits.sol_published_observation: Metric groups, flat charts and the lower Metric/Value table share quiet dividers instead of nested cards.
quality_threshold_audits.individual_image_observation: Five versus four statistic dividers; flat charts; mono ticks; labelled data series; lower summary/detail table repeats values.
quality_threshold_audits.supported: Flat surfaces and quiet dividers are consistent. Desktop uses five-cell and four-cell stat strips with different divider positions plus a summary/detail table. Phone stats begin near x38 versus x16 title/chart headings, with Uptime alone on a third row.
quality_threshold_audits.anchor_difference: Opus 7 weighs layout and data-type differences as vocabulary friction. Sol 9 emphasizes consistent flat framing. These are different emphases on the same evidence.
quality_threshold_audits.qualification: Mono for fixed-width data is explicitly permitted. Chart, statistics and table have different information roles; repetition of summary in detail is not inherently waste. Three incompatible vocabularies is stronger than these facts establish. Phone viewport does not show the lower table.
quality_threshold_audits.resolution: Retain actual alignment/inset concerns; do not turn subjective mixed-vocabulary language into a functional or contract failure.

brand_threshold_audits.opus_published_observation: Busnes dark surfaces; teal and purple chart series are off-palette (arguably data).
brand_threshold_audits.sol_published_observation: Charcoal surfaces and pale ink match the pinned Busnes Dark and KyIdentity dark reference.
brand_threshold_audits.individual_image_observation: Five versus four statistic dividers; flat charts; mono ticks; labelled data series; lower summary/detail table repeats values.
brand_threshold_audits.supported: All four originals show labelled teal Local, orange Forwarded and purple Blocked series on cream/charcoal surfaces.
brand_threshold_audits.anchor_difference: Opus 7 calls series hues off-palette, partly caveated as data. Sol 9 treats labelled series as semantic data colors.
brand_threshold_audits.qualification: The contract permits other hues as user data. Extending that to operational telemetry is an interpretation; exact token provenance cannot be proven by pixels. Automatic violation for all non-chrome data colors is overstated.
brand_threshold_audits.resolution: Record data context and ambiguity; keep separate Ky-fit scores and leave the declined data-color change declined.
